title: Cloud Spells and Engineering RPG
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack built around the Cloud Swords Mod where cloud computing meets Minecraft RPG combat.
body:
![cloudspellsandengmodpack banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18dba95e523846787a02016e170ff0ad8e3dded3_0.webp)
 
 A lightweight Fabric modpack built around the Cloud Swords Mod — where cloud computing meets Minecraft RPG combat.
  Swing swords inspired by AWS services, cast spells named after cloud operations, wear armor that mirrors
  certification levels, and trade with caravan merchants that evolve the more you buy from them.
  
  Pre-configured with Spell Engine, Better Combat, EMI, Trinkets, and quality-of-life mods for the best experience
  out of the box. Just install and play.
  
  Included: 7 cloud-themed swords, 28 spells, 9 spellbooks, 4 armor sets, energy networks, 7 villager professions,
  wandering caravan merchants, animated textures, and full EMI recipe support.
